note: documentation: the guides of the portal document the API of the data (calls recorded in a Postman documentation) and state that open data are read without authentication; no description in OpenAPI or another machine-readable format was found. Terms: the terms of use of the portal (version 1.0, May 2026) cover the API: programmatic access to the datasets is among the tools that the portal provides (Article 1.3); the API is defined (Article 2.5); access needs no registration, fee or justification (Articles 3.1 and 3.6); every user may use the APIs for automated retrieval, integration in applications and the creation of services (Article 3.2); uninterrupted operation is not guaranteed (Article 4.2); the automated retrieval of an abusive volume of data is prohibited (Article 4.3); a general limit of 2,000 calls per minute per IP address applies, which the administrator may change or tighten for specific addresses (Article 4.4). The text sets no criteria of performance or availability and refers to no machine-readable form of the terms
